statements.subject: server
statements.description: Each object in the data array MUST include a @type key that identifies the object's type.
actions: Include a @type key in each object within the error data array
Ensure the @type key identifies the object's type

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Implementations SHOULD use well-known types such as google.rpc.ErrorInfo to refine error reporting, or google.rpc.BadRequest to attach structured data to validation errors.
actions: Use well-known types such as google.rpc.ErrorInfo to refine error reporting
Use google.rpc.BadRequest to attach structured data to validation errors

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Additional error context MAY be included as further objects in the data array.
actions: Include additional error context objects in the error data array beyond the primary error detail object
